title: Brawl2 — Distinct by design

heroes.name: Marcus Ironheart
heroes.traitText: As your reaction while defending, discard a non-Loot card from your hand to gain 2 Block.

ultimate.name: The Walking Wall
ultimate.text: After you finish a non-Loot reaction while defending, you may move 1 space toward the rival.

heroes.weakness: Blocking consumes the same cards needed to attack. Little reach, limited pursuit, no passive card income and no retained Block.
heroes.combo: Every card can keep me standing.

heroes.name: Sibu Stormspear
heroes.traitText: As your reaction during your attack, tuck one non-Loot hand card beneath that attack to add 3 damage. Only one card can be tucked beneath each attack.
heroes.weakness: Major hits are slow and mostly short-range. A miss spends the attack and any tucked card. Weak hero-specific defenses and no draw engine.

heroes.name: Vera Vendetta
heroes.archetype: Flexible duelist / balanced offense and defense
heroes.traitText: Once per round before you commit, you may discard one non-Loot hand card to draw 1.

ultimate.name: Twin Blades
ultimate.text: Once during each of your attacks, you may use that card’s printed Reaction as your reaction without discarding it. Follow its normal timing restrictions.

heroes.weakness: No large passive damage or defense bonus. Filtering gives no extra cards. Last Stand depends on committing useful Dual attacks.
heroes.combo: I have an answer—and a sharp follow-up.

heroes.name: Mei Windwalker
heroes.archetype: Evasive ranged fighter / movement and distance
heroes.traitText: After an enemy attack misses you, you may move up to 1.

ultimate.name: Walk on Air
ultimate.text: Once per round, as your reaction, move up to 2 without playing a card.

heroes.weakness: Low hero-specific Block and modest damage. Several attacks cannot hit at Range 1. Movement still costs hand cards outside her limited Last Stand action.
heroes.combo: Your strike finds empty air. Mine reaches you.

heroes.name: Lord Smasherton
heroes.archetype: Break shields and force positions. Slow, expensive to chase.
heroes.traitText: Your wall slams deal 3 damage instead of 1.

ultimate.name: You're Not Going Anywhere
ultimate.text: After your attack deals Health damage, pin the rival: they cannot move voluntarily until their next attack finishes. Pushes and pulls still work.

heroes.weakness: Slow punches can miss. Draft movement to catch Alf.
heroes.combo: Choose which weakness to cover with your 24 cards.

heroes.name: Alf Featherbottom
heroes.archetype: Prepare your draws and dominate firing distance. Weak at contact.
heroes.traitText: After your attack deals Health damage at Range 3 or farther, draw 1 card.

ultimate.name: Emergency Spring Boots
ultimate.text: When your attack activates, you may move 1 space before its printed movement. The rival then reacts normally.

heroes.weakness: Power Shot cannot hit next door. Draft escapes and close-range backup.
heroes.combo: Choose which weakness to cover with your 24 cards.

heroes.name: Dr. Shealer
heroes.archetype: Spend Health to gain choices and burst; heal by landing attacks.
heroes.traitText: Whenever you pay Health for a card, draw 1 card. Damage from enemies and losing Health to an effect do not trigger this.

ultimate.name: Malpractical Flight
ultimate.text: Your attacks gain +1 maximum Range. Your arena position, minimum Range and enemy attacks are unchanged.

heroes.weakness: Health payments leave you vulnerable. They never grant Fury.
heroes.combo: Choose which weakness to cover with your 24 cards.

heroes.name: Helga Stonewall
heroes.archetype: Bank Block and choose where to spend it. Slow without a shield.
heroes.traitText: When your rival activates an attack, gain 1 Block. All unused Block clears after every attack.

ultimate.name: Hit Me. I Dare You.
ultimate.text: After an enemy attack connects in range, reflect 1 damage, even if fully blocked. Once per attack; ignores Block. Misses and Loot do not trigger it. Resolve reflection before checking victory; simultaneous knockouts draw.

heroes.weakness: Hits can break your shield before you spend it.
heroes.combo: Choose which weakness to cover with your 24 cards.

heroes.name: Raven Madison
heroes.archetype: Cross, disrupt and steal. Low direct damage without positioning.
heroes.traitText: Your first crossing before your own strike gives +2 damage. Crossing while defending gives no Block.

ultimate.name: My Shadow Has Other Plans
ultimate.text: Place your shadow on your space. Once per round, as your reaction, swap places with it. It stays on your old space. It cannot be attacked and does not block spaces. No swap onto the rival or while pinned. Refresh each round.

heroes.weakness: You need a landing space beyond your rival. No facing bookkeeping.
heroes.combo: Choose which weakness to cover with your 24 cards.

heroes.name: Friar Franc
heroes.archetype: Earn, spend and recycle. Coins cannot fund both powers and Loot.
heroes.traitText: When your Basic Attack deals Health damage, earn 1 extra Coin when it finishes. A miss still earns the normal 1 Coin.

ultimate.name: The Emergency Stash
ultimate.text: Draw 1 free Loot on activation; at two Loot, you may replace one before drawing. As your reaction, buy Loot for 1 Coin, holding at most two. Your opponent responds before you can play it.

heroes.weakness: The finisher still needs Range. Your first card reveals your setup.
heroes.combo: Choose which weakness to cover with your 24 cards.

rules: Build your fight
Choose any 24 cards from your Hero’s 40-card pool: 20 designs, two copies each. No point budget or Basic/Hero quotas. Choose one of three Fury cards; keep it outside the deck.
Start
20 Health, 0 Coins. Start on spaces 3 and 6; random Edge. Shuffle your deck and draw 7.
Commit
Secretly choose two Attack-capable cards in order. A Dual card uses one half only. If you have fewer than two Attacks, commit those you have; missing slots pass.
Reveal & speed

Flip the first pair. Apply printed adjacent speed reductions. Reveal payments are optional, offered in Edge order. Then lock attack order: higher Speed first; Edge wins ties. Movement cannot change that order.
Activate & react

Resolve printed preparation and movement. Then the defender reacts first. Alternate one Reaction, Loot or pass. Playing a card resets passes; two consecutive passes resolve the strike at the current distance. Draw only when a card or passive says so.
Movement

Move up to the printed distance, in either direction. You may stay, move partly or cross the rival, but never share a space or leave the eight-space arena. Choose when the effect resolves. Push and pull also allow zero or partial movement.
Scry & preparation

Scry: privately look at the top cards, choose their order on top, and put unselected cards underneath. No draw. Alf’s preparation then publicly reveals and bottoms the top card: Attack-capable gives +2 damage and ignores 2 Block; otherwise minimum Range becomes 1 and maximum Range gains 2.
Payments & discards

Printed reaction costs are paid before effects. Discard another means a different uncommitted hand card. An opponent forced to discard chooses their own card. Optional pre-reaction Health payments are spent even if the attack later misses. All Health costs leave at least 1 Health.
Card draw & recovery

Only one printed draw effect per player per active attack. Explicit draws may exceed 7. Recover only the specified Basic Reaction already played in this exchange; never recover a committed Attack or a prior exchange’s card.
Finish the round

Finish both attacks in the first pair, then reveal and resolve pair two. Keep unused cards. Draw up to 4, stopping at 7 in hand. No free discard. Refill an empty deck by shuffling your discard. Edge alternates.
Win
Reduce the rival to 0 Health; stop immediately. At round 10 cleanup both lose 2 Health, then one more per later round, capped at 18. Simultaneous knockouts are a draw.
Fury & Last Stand

Base passives work from the start. At 10 Health or less, your chosen Fury enters your hand once. The first time you reach 5 Health or less, finish the current card; if you survive, activate Last Stand for the rest of the fight, even if you heal. Last Stand replaces the old passive upgrade. A lethal hit does not unlock it. Helga’s already-active reflection resolves before victory.
Coins
Basic Attacks earn 1 Coin when they finish, even on a miss. Franc earns 1 extra only when his Basic Attack deals Health damage. Reactions give no automatic income. Hold at most 8 Coins.
Arena

Join the two Heroes’ four-space boards to make a straight 8-space arena. Number the spaces 1–8. Start on 3 and 6. Only the outer ends (1 and 8) are walls. Crossing the join between 4 and 5 has no special effect.
Loot draft & market

Each Hero chooses 6 different Loot from their 12-card pool. Shuffle both contributions into one shared 12-card deck. Reveal 3. Anyone can use any Loot. Between rounds, starting with the new Edge holder, each player may buy once: pay 2 Coins for a face-up Loot or a blind draw. Refill a bought slot immediately. Hold at most 2 Loot. Shuffle spent Loot when the draw pile empties; never shuffle held or face-up cards.
Block

All unused Block clears after every attack, for everyone. Maximum 6 Block. Helga gains 1 Block when a rival activates an attack, before printed movement and reactions. No Block banking or round-end exceptions.
Hero passives

Passives work from the start. Alf draws once after a damaging attack from Range 3 or farther. This is a passive draw, independent of the once-per-attack card-draw limit. Shealer draws 1 whenever she pays Health for a card; this is also a passive draw. Smasherton improves wall slams; Raven rewards crossing before her strike; Franc earns an extra Coin only when a Basic Attack deals Health damage.

builds.name: The Unbroken
builds.plan: Practice spending cards to survive, then advancing behind the shield. This is the defensive extreme, not a recommended mandatory list.
builds.weakness: Blocking consumes the same cards needed to attack. Little reach, limited pursuit, no passive card income and no retained Block.

builds.name: The Big Opening
builds.plan: Includes Basic income and movement so the largest hit is a choice rather than the only plan.
builds.weakness: Major hits are slow and mostly short-range. A miss spends the attack and any tucked card. Weak hero-specific defenses and no draw engine.

builds.name: Always an Answer
builds.plan: Flexible first-play deck. Swap toward V01/V07 for finishing power or V06/V08 for Twin Blades utility.
builds.weakness: No large passive damage or defense bonus. Filtering gives no extra cards. Last Stand depends on committing useful Dual attacks.

builds.name: Never Where You Expect
builds.plan: Demonstrates spacing and evasion while retaining a Basic close-range answer and some Block.
builds.weakness: Low hero-specific Block and modest damage. Several attacks cannot hit at Range 1. Movement still costs hand cards outside her limited Last Stand action.
